Name: Foxies Cozy Living Farmhouse
Author: Cott0nFoxiee
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Foxie’s Cozy Living Farmhouse[/size][/b][/center]
[size=3]Foxie’s Cozy Living Farmhouse transforms your home in Stardew Valley into a warm, spacious, and thoughtfully reimagined living space.This mod fully redesigns the farmhouse interior with a more open layout, smoother room flow, and expanded areas for creative decoration. Instead of feeling like a simple starter house, your home becomes a place that feels lived-in, personal, and naturally connected.The redesign focuses on both comfort and flexibility. Larger open spaces give you freedom to decorate, while subtle structure keeps each area intentional and cozy. A newly added sunroom brings in soft natural light, creating the perfect spot for plants, relaxation, or quiet moments.Built as my very first mod (created on mobile using Winlator), this project will continue to grow and improve over time.[/size][b][size=4] [/size][/b]
[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
• Fully Reimagined Farmhouse Interior
A complete overhaul of the original layout with a more open and cohesive design.
• New Sunroom Area
A bright and cozy space designed for decoration, plants, or relaxation.
• Improved Layout Flow
Rooms are connected more naturally, making movement feel smoother and more intuitive.
• Decoration-Friendly Spaces
Wider and more flexible areas that give you more freedom to design your home.
[b][size=4]Future Updates[/size][/b]
• Farmhouse Renovation Options
Planned additions that allow multiple layout or style variations.
• Attic Expansion
A new attic space for extra functionality, storage, or customization.
• More Detail & Polish
Additional visual improvements and refinements to enhance the cozy atmosphere.

[b][size=4]⚠️ Known Issues[/size][/b]
• Fridge is not accessible
The fridge cannot currently be opened. As a temporary workaround, please use chests for storage.
• Possible minor bugs
As this is an early version, some issues may still occur

[b][size=4]Requirements [/size][/b]
Make sure you have the following installed:
• Content Patcher
• Luan Indoor Tilesheet
• Sharogg Tilesheet
• MMAP

[b][size=4]Installation [/size][/b]
1. Install SMAPI
2. Download and install all required mods listed above
3. Extract this mod into your:   
     ↳Stardew Valley/Mods
4. Launch the game using SMAPI
5. Done! Your farmhouse is now fully redesigned
